notes:
Continue Watching cards are now the same poster size and shape as every other row, so the home screen reads as one grid instead of two. The same poster shape is now used everywhere — search, My List, Continue Watching and the browse grids.

Search now waits for you to press OK instead of searching on every keypress, so the results stop churning while you are still spelling a word. The recent-search chips are gone for now.

The on-screen "Back" buttons have been removed — your remote's Back button does the same thing, and they were taking the first focus on every screen.
